decision_scope: Measured benefit is raw Fire command submission in two native processes; exact pixels cover Water/Fire/Steam and controls. Not overall FPS, GPU/presentation, Garden or Mantle speed acceptance.
units: CPU submission microseconds; paired delta is candidate minus reference; negative favors candidate
method: 64 measured pairs with32 actual draws in each order;2 warmup pairs excluded; processB starts opposite order and omits pixel readback. Descriptive statistics, no independent-sample confidence claim.
review: Experience reviewed rendering and fallback; gameplay reviewed finite paid workload and timing-only mode; root accepted narrow retention.
limitations: Garden workload.tick repeats the preceding Mantle tick2716; actual Garden draw uses entry.tick and active phase. Preserve original receipts; do not interpret2716 as Garden time.
A has prior pixel/cache history;B initializes from a fresh process. Exact per-case authority hashes and recorded region counts agree, but cache histories differ.
Strong first-draw/order effects remain, especially in unchanged Garden controls. Do not pool modes/orders without showing them.
Water/Steam have exact appearance/fallback coverage, but separate speed improvements were not measured.
The derived changed-fill count is source/region-based, not an instrumented submission counter.
